# International Hair Transplant Clinic

> International Hair Transplant Clinic (IHTC) is a hair restoration clinic located at Paseo del Centenario 9580, Zona Urbana Rio Tijuana 22010, Baja California, Mexico — 30 minutes from San Diego. We perform hair transplants using a combined FUE+DHI technique applied together in every procedure. One approach, one price, permanent natural results. Performed by Dr. Erik Yáñez — US citizen, bilingual physician trained at Universidad Autónoma de Baja California.

## Our Technique

At IHTC, every hair transplant uses **FUE (Follicular Unit Extraction) combined with DHI (Direct Hair Implantation)** — not as separate options, but as a single unified approach applied in every procedure.

- **FUE** is used for the extraction phase: individual follicles are harvested one by one from the donor area using micro-punches. No linear scar.
- **DHI** is used for the implantation phase: extracted follicles are placed using the Choi Implanter Pen for precise control over angle, depth, and direction.

This combined FUE+DHI method is how we work — every time, for every patient. There is no "FUE-only" or "DHI-only" option at our clinic. The combination delivers maximum density, natural hairline design, and minimally invasive results.

## Services

### Hair Restoration
- **FUE+DHI Hair Transplant**: Our standard procedure, combining both techniques in every session. Current promotional pricing available — see homepage.
- **Hairline Restoration**: Custom-designed natural frontal hairline for patients with receding hairlines.
- **Crown Restoration**: Treating hair loss and thinning at the vertex (crown) area.
- **High-Density Restoration**: Adding density to areas with existing hair.
- **Custom Hairline Design Session**: Included with every procedure.
- **Post-Op Care**: Fully included — written instructions and WhatsApp support throughout recovery.

**Q: What technique do you use?**
A: We always use FUE and DHI combined — in every procedure, for every patient. FUE is used during the extraction phase; DHI (via Choi Implanter Pen) is used during the implantation phase. We don't offer FUE-only or DHI-only procedures.

**Q: Can I return home the same day?**

**Q: When will I see results?**

**Q: Do you offer free consultations?**
